Delivery work progressed more consistently than recovery work throughout the week.
Stress and fatigue rose during meeting-heavy periods, while better sleep aligned with calmer emotion signals and lower fatigue by the end of the week.
nextSuggestions: Close the recovery gap by finishing the sleep trend check and unblocking the missed-call review in two short, clearly scoped sessions.
Keep using smaller, explicit focus blocks and a simple restart step after meetings to reduce interruption fallout.
Protect energy on short-sleep days by scheduling a recharge break before late-day work and keeping priorities limited to the highest-value task.
